name: nGZSceneGraph::cDataListItem::Create
notes: Lane OX (scenegraph D1a): nGZSceneGraph::cDataListItem is our class (src/sg/cDataListItem.h): one named, typed value of a data list (cIDataListItem 0x6a7b33bb, 37 slots): a bool, Sint32, float, two to four floats, a string, a byte array or a counted list of items, persisted three ways (persist writer / reader, binary stream, text). Hooked: the COM director's factory 0xac6d50 (its only reference is the director's class table; cDataListExtension and the items' own Read / ReadStream / Parse make items only through the COM), so the game's constructor, destructor, vtable 0xe78344 and every slot body are never reached (their entries here, in effect through callers). Ours keeps the game's layout (the name's 8 bytes at +4, the type at +0xc, the count at +0x10, the value words at +0x14) because two behaviours depend on it: getters of another type read the old words, and a long name set over a short one (0xac6ae0 does not zero the marker byte: ORIGINAL-BUG, reproduced) reads on into the type word. GetBool (13) answers the first value byte as it is (0x16db30 is a plain byte getter). Our GetItem past the end answers null where the original answers the list head's unwritten value word (not tested: undefined). Tests (tests/sg_data_list_item.cpp): SG_DataListItem_Slots (150 seeds: six items per side from each side's factory, the COM framework getter 0x1ae18d stood in on both sides; a seeded run of every setter, MakeList, AddItem, RemoveAt (negative, past the end), Remove, SetName (the bug state checked, then cleared), SetString(null), QueryInterface; after each the getters, every item's count, the heap balance of value operations, and every few operations each item's Write / WriteStream / Describe tapes), SG_DataListItem_Read / _ReadStream (the game side's tapes read back on both sides, also with type bytes changed), SG_DataListItem_Parse (Describe's text parsed back, and generated lines failing or passing each check). Mutants (tools/mutate.py, build/ox_dli_mutants*.json): 47 distinct, 45 killed, 2 equivalent: SetType without its same-type check (only numeric setters reach it, and clearing a numeric value frees nothing and keeps the words), and Describe's string case breaking instead of returning (the same line end follows the switch). Six first-run survivors (FindByName case, the Read / ReadStream / Parse child release, Read's Clear, the line-feed erase) and the byte limit 0xff vs 0x100 were killed after the test gained find-case, child counts, prefilled targets and edge lines.
